ruleName: Dropping a Ball in Relief Area
title: Dropping below knee height
question: In stroke play, James drops his ball from well below knee height. The ball comes to rest in the relief area and James plays a stroke. What is the ruling?
explanation: James must drop the ball from knee height when taking relief. If he drops it from well below knee height and plays it from the relief area, he receives a one-stroke penalty under Rule 14.3b.
